Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: ONE independent 1x1-square-footprint sensor component icon for this exact cultivation-game formation plate. The supplied image B is the HIGHEST AND ONLY visual reference. It is a style and exact component-design reference, NOT an edit target. Match the TOP-LEFT sensor in B: a short ivory bone-jade needle LYING FLAT and pointing LEFT, held by a grey-brown ancient bronze U-shaped / forked cradle. Redraw ONLY that one small component as a standalone icon, NOT the plate, not a crop containing its background or connected wire.

Composition: square canvas, entire single component visible with a safe transparent margin all around. Strong simple silhouette legible when displayed at 64 pixels. The short pale ivory needle projects leftward from the open left side of the angular copper U cradle. The cradle wraps around its right/base end and has two short angular arms. A tiny subdued grey-celadon patina accent may sit on the copper, in the same palette as B. The needle is horizontal in the image and physically lies flat, not standing upright. STRICT exact 90-degree orthographic TOP VIEW: only top faces and very shallow painted edges, never a vertical cylinder, raised post, sidewall, slanted camera or 3D pedestal.

Exactly ONE functional outlet, at the RIGHTMOST SIDE CENTER facing EAST: a small pale-copper contact mouth with an EXTREMELY SHORT muted cinnabar groove core inside the mouth. This is the signal OUTPUT. It is part of the component silhouette. Do NOT draw a wire projecting out of it. No other colored ports anywhere, no modern metal connector pins, no extra inlets. Keep the tiny red groove short and inset so it reads as a socket contact, not a red cable stub.

Match B's actual project hand-painted style closely: confident dark ink contour, broad simplified matte color planes, hand-painted dry brush marks in grey-brown bronze and a little muted celadon, ivory narrow edge highlights, dark-grey painted shadow planes. Low-tier, plain functional fantasy component. No realistic engraved metal microtexture, photorealistic sculpture, glossy 3D render, ornate jewel decoration, glow, neon or high polish. No separate cast ground shadow; any dark area must belong to the object's own contour or painted shallow edge.

TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. No formation disk, plate floor, other components, tabletop, square tile background, border, icon frame, text, letters, digits, labels, UI, grid, shield, flags, extra decorative props, wires, particles or ambient shadow outside the object. One original native-resolution PNG; preserve actual transparency.
